decision_rule.near_tolerance_meaning: a pair of issuers whose REFERENCE EV/EBITDA differ by less than 5% of their mean is counted as agreeing whichever way the rung orders them; exact agreement counts no such indulgence
decision_rule.returns_may_not_promote: survivor_return_diagnostic() is never read by verdict(). It is a SURVIVOR_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC measured on 2,574 listings all alive in 2026, whose median member underperforms the total market by -7.45% at 12M. If the ranking result and the return result disagree, the ranking result wins, and the disagreement is reported as a disagreement.
decision_rule.sentence: If a lower rung adds enormous coverage while preserving nearly the same ordering, that's useful. If it materially reshuffles valuation, don't promote it simply because it fills cells.
decision_rule.stated_by: the owner, before the measurement was run

threshold_history.change: every threshold in this block was registered in the source before the measurement was executed

MIN_POOLED_PAIRS added. MIN_POOLED_SAMPLE gates issuer-dates while the agreement rate and the decile churn are computed over pairs; LongTermDebt cleared 224 issuer-dates and produced 149 pairs, 1-2 per date, where a cheap decile is one name in two. A second floor can only move a rung TO UNDETERMINED, never to a promotion.
threshold_history.effect: LongTermDebt: PROMOTE (+6.7 points of base, 98.66% near agreement, 5.95% churn, 149 pairs) -> UNDETERMINED

headline.answer_in_one_line: the ordering survives nearly intact -- every rung with enough co-tagged priced issuers to measure keeps 97.7% to 98.3% of pairwise EV/EBITDA ordering against the exact total -- but the CHEAPEST DECILE, which is the part a decision is taken on, churns 14.1% to 22.6%. The recovery is real enough to keep and not clean enough to pool: EV/EBITDA needs a debt data-quality factor, not a bigger denominator.
headline.question: does concept_ladder_v2's total_debt coverage recovery survive a ranking test, or does it only fill cells?

representativeness_of_the_ranking_sample.calendar_note: the thin months are a SHARE-COUNT artefact, not a debt one: `pit_rawprice.market_cap_as_of` resolves the cover-page count under the v1 twelve-month bound, which is the calendar artefact `fact_kind_staleness_v2` was written to remove. This module does not patch the frozen price path to get a bigger sample.
representativeness_of_the_ranking_sample.gate: the exact rung requires ShortTermBorrowings, filed by fewer than one issuer in eleven
representativeness_of_the_ranking_sample.why_direction_is_unknown: an untagged ShortTermBorrowings may be a real zero or an untagged amount, and pit_policy.absence_limits() records that this store cannot separate never_tagged from tagged_zero -- 159,522 empty-valued rows were counted and discarded at ingest. So the measured churn is not declared an upper or a lower bound.

headline.what_is_still_unmeasurable: a rung listed under UNDETERMINED is not cleared and not condemned. Too few co-tagged, priced issuers carry it beside the exact total to rank it, and that is reported as the answer rather than filled in with the nearest plausible number.
headline.what_it_implies_for_the_provenance_multi: rung quality varies materially and measurably -- near ordering agreement and cheap-decile churn differ across rungs by more than their sampling error -- so an EV/EBITDA computed on a lower-bound rung is NOT the same measurement as one computed on the exact total, and presenting them in one percentile without a quality factor asserts that they are. Q is proposed per rung, for the DEBT dimension alone; no combination rule with PeerCoherence is proposed, because the owner has not chosen one.

quality_factor_proposal.applies_to: ev_ebitda (and any factor whose input is total_debt)
quality_factor_proposal.combination_rule_with_peer_coherence: NOT PROPOSED -- the owner has not chosen it, and this module measures one dimension
quality_factor_proposal.definition: Q(rung) = pooled near ordering agreement of that rung's EV/EBITDA ranking against the exact-total ranking
